title: EOS A/B Pair Readiness — Canonical Input Contract
description: THE single input contract for evaluate_pair_readiness(). Raw Itential / CVP / Device Broker payloads MUST be normalized into this shape before evaluation. The evaluator never understands vendor- or platform-specific response formats.

field_status.description: Verification provenance per field group. Operational groups (mlag, bgp, interfaces) remain 'unverified' until live show-command / Device Broker operational responses are captured in lab.

version.description: EOS version provenance (e.g. CVP softwareVersion / version)

mlag.description: UNVERIFIED until live MLAG operational-command responses are captured

bgp.description: UNVERIFIED until live BGP summary operational-command responses are captured

interfaces.description: UNVERIFIED until live interface-status operational-command responses are captured

mlag_state.description: Canonical MLAG state (e.g. 'active'). null when field_status.mlag is unverified.

mlag_peer_state.description: Canonical MLAG peer state (e.g. 'connected'). null when field_status.mlag is unverified.

bgp_established.description: Established BGP neighbor count. null when field_status.bgp is unverified.

bgp_expected.description: Expected BGP neighbor count. null when field_status.bgp is unverified.

critical_interfaces_up.description: Critical interfaces up. null when field_status.interfaces is unverified.

critical_interfaces_expected.description: Critical interfaces expected. null when field_status.interfaces is unverified.
